title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR) / Resolutive Database Engine
description: BDR v1.2.0-rc2 is a published pre-release candidate in the v1.2 line. It preserves the v1.1 atomic BDW4 persistence model and validates the Atomic C ABI v2 and Memoria.ia integration contract, including multi-operation PerOperationSync as one logical batch, one sequence and one all-or-nothing recovery boundary. Software release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22821283. The associated scientific preprint is a separate Zenodo publication with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21937842.
